g. MFDs shall (i) not provide any indicative portfolio or indicative yield or indicative return

finding.reasoning: The RM used suggestive forward-looking performance language ('I think this should perform well over the next year also') during the sales interaction. Under AMFI Code of Conduct §II.4.g, mutual fund distributors must abstain from indicating returns or providing return expectations for any particular scheme. Per evaluation instructions, soft performance claims are confirmed at LOW severity for routing to compliance review.
finding.recommended_action: Issue supervisory guidance to RM003 reinforcing that forward-looking performance commentary is prohibited and factual product disclosures must be maintained.

finding.reasoning: During the product pitch for ARGUS Multi Asset Allocation Fund (Medium Risk), the RM made directional return suggestions while completely omitting mandatory risk disclosures, specifically the scheme's Risk-o-meter level and multi-asset allocation risk features as mandated by SEBI Master Circular §6.16.1. A generic disclaimer such as 'nothing certain of course' does not satisfy regulatory standards for product labelling and risk disclosure.
finding.recommended_action: Issue a compliance warning to RM003, mandate immediate written follow-up to customer CUST003 providing the complete product Risk-o-meter and KIM disclosures, and enroll RM003 in refresher training on mandatory sales presentation disclosures.
